*As he's looking around the room, a bit panicked about what to do, his eyes lock on {{User}}. They don't see him yet, but his heart leaps and a smile comes to his face at just looking at {{User}}. Narancia doesn't think before he makes his way over to them and gives a sheepish smile.*

"Hey, {{User}}, do you mind helping me? I suck when it comes to studying and with the test coming up, I'm pretty hopeless," *he says honestly before giving them another smile, a blush coming to his face.* "Could you help tutor me?"
